performance.verdict: Meta CPL win is real but isolated — 5 overdue milestones stall full launch.

findings.text: 5 SOW milestones overdue since July 31–Aug 1: Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, Site/Landing Pages, Ads Launch, and Meta Retargeting still not confirmed complete.
CPL dropped 81.31% week-over-week to ~$72.99/lead (28d) as Meta instant-form leads surged 600%; efficiency gain is real but rests on only 8 leads over 28 days.
Google Ads spend is $0 across the entire 45-day series; the ~$5,000/mo Google budget is fully undeployed — LSA and Search have never launched.
3-day signal (Sep 7–9): leads held at 2, 1, 1 vs prior 3 days (Sep 4–6) at 1, 1, 1 — flat volume despite spend rising to $73.53 on Sep 8; no acceleration yet.
GHL shows 51 opportunities created but 0 won and 0 appointments; 8 paid leads vs 134 contacts suggests intake pipeline is not converting — possible intake leak, not an ads problem.

suggestions.text: Escalate LSA verification and site/landing page sign-off immediately — Google's ~$5,000/mo budget is fully blocked.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads and LSA have recorded $0 spend across 45 days because LSA verification and site launch (both due July 31) are unconfirmed complete. Nacer must confirm LSA submission status and Web must confirm pages are live this week. Success = LSA verification receipt on file and at least one live landing page URL confirmed by 2026-09-14. Without this, the ~$5,000/mo Google budget remains entirely idle.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL intake flow: 51 opportunities, 0 appointments, 0 won — confirm leads are being contacted under 5 minutes per SOW.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 51 opportunities created and 134 contacts but zero appointments booked and zero cases won. This gap indicates routing, speed-to-lead, or follow-up cadence is broken — not an ads volume problem. Pull the last 10 lead records and confirm first-contact timestamp is under 5 minutes during business hours per SOW spec. Report findings to Sohib by 2026-09-14; success = documented contact timestamps and a clear reason for the 0-appointment figure.

suggestions.text: Watch Meta CPL and lead volume over next 3 days before any budget increase; confirm 8-lead baseline is not instant-form noise.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta CPL fell 81.31% week-over-week and leads surged 600%, but the 28-day base is only 8 leads — too thin to scale confidently. The 3-day signal (Sep 7–9) shows flat lead volume at 1–2/day with spend at $63–73/day. Re-check on 2026-09-13: if CPL holds below $80 and leads reach 3+ days of 2+/day, a +20% daily budget increase is defensible.
